citations.claim: energy exceeds allowed 2684.42 at violating step
heavy body velocity explodes after simultaneous contact

counterfactual.change: Reduced body 1 initial vy from -58.017 to -10 (single field vy) to avoid high-speed simultaneous floor+body collision; energy stays bounded.

explanation: Energy jumps 13.5kJ in one step (1065J at step30 -> 14653J at step31, limit 2684J) with no controller work. Both bodies converge on floor simultaneously: heavy body0 (m19.3) resting on floor (y=radius at step31) and light fast body1 impacts it from above while also near floor. Positional correction / impulse for overlapping body-body and body-floor constraints adds energy instead of conserving it, slingshotting body0 from vx -1.9 to +38.4 m/s. Lowering impact speed eliminates blow-up.
vision_note: Steps 28-30 show a small upper body falling vertically toward a larger lower body already nearly touching the floor. At step 31 the two bodies visibly interpenetrate/overlap at the floor line instead of cleanly colliding and separating, indicating a simultaneous body-body and body-floor contact resolution failure.
